endScreen.title: End of the demo
endScreen.text: Thanks for playing! The road from Barrelsby goes on…

intro.text: For weeks, a stranger has been seen on the edge of Barrelsby.
He promises the townsfolk riches if they follow him into the woods. Some already have, and none have come back.

intro.speaker: yasmi
intro.text: Then we go to him. East road, into the woods.
Click the ground to walk.   Press T to set the party's tactics. Fights play out on their own.

forestEdge.text: The road narrows as the trees close in. Fresh footprints lead east, many of them.

forestEdge.speaker: hyne
forestEdge.text: Townsfolk. They walked this way willingly.

meetStranger.text: Ahead, in a clearing, a tall figure in a dark coat waits as if he expected company.

meetStranger.speaker: stranger
meetStranger.text: More visitors from Barrelsby. Have you come to get rich, too?

meetStranger.speaker: yasmi
meetStranger.text: We've come to bring our people home.

meetStranger.speaker: stranger
meetStranger.text: Then you'll have to take them from me.

strangerDefeated.text: The Stranger falls. Deeper in the woods, voices: the missing townsfolk, dazed but alive.

strangerDefeated.speaker: oxleth
strangerDefeated.text: He wasn't working alone. Someone gave him that power.
